newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Janz ups Pacific Beef stake to 90.02 pct.
newsitem.headline: Janz ups Pacific Beef stake to 90.02 pct.

text.p: Janz Investments on Tuesday said it now held 90.02 percent of the shares in New Zealand's Pacific Beef Ltd and intended to proceed to obtain the remaining 9.98 percent by way of compulsory acquisition.
The compulsory acquisition price offered would be 80 NZ cents per share, the same as that offered by Janz in its takeover bid.
The Janz takeover offer remained open for acceptance, concurrently with the compulsory acquisition procedures, until at least September 16, Janz said.
Janz is a syndicate comprising Asian New Zealand Meat Co Ltd (ANZCO), Rangatira Ltd, Itoham Foods Inc and Nippon Suisan Kaisha.
